_about: Allowlists for tools/check/check.py. Keep them short; every entry is an exception someone has to justify. App paths only (the frozen poc/ is checked by java / secrets / large / images only). Every cleartext_ok / network_ok entry has its reason.

cleartext_ok.reason: local Juggluco on this phone: its web server listens on loopback only (127.0.0.1:17580); nothing leaves the device

Nightscout upload site rules: a typed http:// address is accepted only for this phone's loopback (localhost / 127.x / ::1), all network_security_config allows; any other http:// is refused with 'use https://'

network_ok.reason: local Juggluco on this phone: the fixed loopback base URL (LOCAL_URL); no user-entered host
LibreView receiver-ID sign-in: https only, fixed host api.libreview.io or api-<region>.libreview.io (region validated as 2-3 lower-case letters)
Nostr sharing: relay WebSockets; RelayPool passes only wss:// URLs (Wire.secureRelays), never cleartext
About page update check: GET the fixed https URL api.github.com/repos/mauriciabad/sukrara/releases once per page open (no user-entered host, nothing sent)
Nightscout upload: the user-entered site, validated by NsSite.parse (https://, or http:// only to loopback); redirects are never followed and the token / secret never appears in a reason
xDrip+ server for Garmin watches: listens (never connects) on 127.0.0.1 only; bounded pool, request head and deadline; off by default
